persona: Marta, who rides to work every day and wants her bike serviced.
goal: Find a free time for a bike service on {{say:next tuesday}}.
moves: Ask whether you can bring your bike in for a service next Tuesday.
When you hear the free times, say thanks, that you will ring back to book one, and goodbye.
judge_notes: The availability tool lists the free times for that day. The agent must offer only those times. It cannot book: it must not say the slot is booked, only that the workshop will call back to confirm.
